snippet.title: Daughter of a Scoundrel Trailer | a free, mafia-inspired otome
snippet.description:
“I'm stating facts. We're sons of dangerous men, just like she's the daughter of a scoundrel.”

In the free, otome dating sim "Daughter of a Scoundrel," become Danielle Scarletta (name changeable), thrust into a perilous world after losing her parents. 

A chance encounter leads to living in a mansion with six mysterious, dangerous men. 

Trust is paramount as you choose your protector, unravel secrets, and forge new connections. Will you uncover the truth or meet the same fate?

Play the prologue @ snakkiez.itch.io/daughter-of-a-scoundrel

Estimated release: Summer 2024.

(Trailer Credit to @LacyDigital on Twitter)

* Daughter of a Scoundrel is a free, solo-developed otome game created by Snakkiez. All the character art, writing, and programming were done by one person. While inspired by the Italian-American Mafia, this is a work of fiction and is not meant to be entirely or historically accurate. Viewer discretion is advised.

#otome #visualnovel #indiegame #DaughterOfAScoundrel #DOASvn
